name: OKC_K_PARTY_ROLES_B_H
description:
A contract is an agreement between at least two or more parties. Each party has a defined role within a contract. The primary roles for a party are Buyer and Seller (Vendor) but there can be other roles which may be defined like third party, buyer etc.
Each party will have contacts which are captured as party contacts child entities.

columns.name: ID
columns.description: primary key for Contract Party.

columns.name: MAJOR_VERSION
columns.description: Major Version Number

columns.name: VERSION_TYPE
columns.description: VERSION_TYPE can have 3 values: C, A & H. Updates are allowed only if the Version_Type is 'C'

columns.name: CHR_ID
columns.description: ID of the contract for which this party role is defined. Refers to ID in OKC_K_HEADERS_B.

columns.name: CLE_ID
columns.description: ID of contract line for which this party role is defined. Refers to ID of OKC_K_LINES_B.

columns.name: PARTY_ROLE_PUID
columns.description: Party Role PUID

columns.name: DNZ_CHR_ID
columns.description: Contract ID. Denormalized for performance.

columns.name: RLE_CODE
columns.description: Role the party plays in the contract. Refers to Party Roles setup.

columns.name: OBJECT1_ID1
columns.description: Identifier1 of the party in the source system.

columns.name: OBJECT1_ID2
columns.description: Identifier2 of the party in the source system.

columns.name: SIGNED_BY
columns.description: Capture the name of the person signing the contract. Must have a value if contract type requires a signature. Will be editable only once the contract is approved.

columns.name: SIGNED_DATE
columns.description: Captures the date when contract is signed.

columns.name: JTOT_OBJECT1_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the source of the party, setup via Party Role Sources which point to JTF Objects (arbitrary view definitions).

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.description:
External key that uniquely identifies a record.  
This column must be populated if updating records via web service and internal fusion id is not known.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_KEY2
columns.description:
Additional attribute to qualify external key. 
For e.g., if customer has multiple external systems all integrated with a single Fusion DB, the keys from 2 systems may collide. 
This is a required attribute that should be populated to further qualify the external key
